title: Fully indoor
description: Worthing's only indoor shopping centre — 20+ stores under one roof, whatever the weather.

title: Central location
description: Right in the heart of Worthing town centre, a short stroll from the seafront.

title: Open seven days
description: Open every day of the week, from 8am Monday to Saturday and 9:30am on Sundays.

title: Family friendly
description: A toy shop, a chocolate factory and escape rooms — the small ones are well looked after.

title: Venue hire
description: An auditorium, meeting rooms and coworking space, available through Rooms.

title: Retail lettings
description: Join the centre — unit enquiries are handled by Flude Property Consultants.
